versions.changelog:
Initial release of cn-color-converter — a color format conversion tool.

- Supports converting between HEX, RGB, RGBA, HSL, HSLA, and CMYK formats.
- Provides command-line options to convert colors, preview them in ASCII, and generate color palettes.
- Includes support for commonly used input formats: #RGB, #RRGGBB, rgb(), and hsl().
- Usage examples and parameter options are documented for easy reference.
